steps.content: My poor child, you have nothing left... Come with me, at least you'll meet others like you. You can even plan your revenge. I'll show you how...

steps.speaker: Vague Phantom
steps.content: Are you sure I can have these beautiful clothes? Thank you! You're like my mom, Garofano! Oh... sorry, I mean sister!

steps.speaker: Vague Phantom
steps.content: I feel a bit embarrassed calling you big sis... You came here before I did and have taught me so much. To me, you'll always be a senior I respect from the bottom of my heart...

steps.speaker: Vague Phantom
steps.content: D-don't think I'd fall for your trick! Just wait, I'll be back!

steps.speaker: Vague Phantom
steps.content: Alright, now, no one can threaten us anymore. Severed, hushed, goodbye~

steps.speaker: Vague Phantom
steps.content: From today on, you can take whatever job you like, butcher whoever you need to at the price you ask for, go wherever you want. You may even leave if that suits you. You don't take orders from anyone anymore, except me.

steps.speaker: Vague Phantom
steps.content: Not even hatred restrains the Garden now. I give you freedom. It's your own life, squander it the way you want. As your Mentor, I permit it.
I've lived for myself... I've found my treasure...
I'd rather die than let anyone hurt them... You can dream of getting past me...
A heavy blow strikes her left shoulder and sends her to the other end of the track.
It's a familiar figure. She had cleared the villa of the Mania sorcery, but the accumulated contamination had already exceeded tolerable limits.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: What happened to you? Shouldn't you be in the villa? How did you escape?

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: ...You carry the scent of her blood, what happened?

She asked, but such a question was now pointless. They were like two beasts deeply corrupted. The Mania rampaged within them, and even a greater amount of 'Blue Rain' would be just a drop in the bucket.
